resources.string: Scrollable personal note with free emoji stickers, colorful glow, and custom backgrounds.
%1$d free emoji stickers · remove with the text

Long-press an empty home screen spot → Widgets → 小小筆記. Choose a note, then long-press to resize.

Text tools: select text to apply colors, rainbow, or glow. With no selection, the effect applies to the whole note. Background fade only affects the background.

The 31 built-in emoji stickers come from Twemoji v14.0.3. The graphics are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, which allows commercial use with attribution. See docs/ASSET_SOURCES_PLAY.md and the Twemoji license file in the project.
